goal: #076: read-only audit of loop_fusion rotation constraints and corrected odometry orientation
scope: No source/configuration/control changes; static inspection of pinned source plus offline analysis of existing 074-02 artifacts.

runtime_identity.loop_mode_reason: pose_graph_node loads a fresh stereo-IMU session and explicitly calls setIMUFlag(true); the pinned source dispatches this mode to optimize4DoF.

optimizer_audit.state_variables: x,y,z and yaw; roll/pitch are held from the VIO keyframe attitude when the 4DoF residual is constructed.
optimizer_audit.neighbor_edges: four previous same-sequence neighbors are added where available; yaw residual is direct and these residual blocks have no robust loss.
optimizer_audit.loop_edges: three translation residuals plus PnP relative-yaw residual; the loop yaw residual is divided by 10, and the loop block alone uses HuberLoss(0.1).
optimizer_audit.angle_unit: Utility::R2ypr returns degrees and NormalizeAngle wraps at +/-180 degrees; the 1/10 loop yaw scale is applied to degree-valued yaw residuals.
optimizer_audit.post_optimization: optimized keyframe poses establish r_drift/t_drift; in IMU mode r_drift is built from yaw difference only. Subsequent odometry_rect orientations are multiplied by r_drift (and the sequence transform), while previously published samples are not republished.

interpretation.evidence_supported: The loop yaw target is explicitly weakened relative to the local VIO yaw edges; in the final graph snapshot the loop-edge yaw residuals shrink only slightly and remain 0.451-1.224 degrees. The measured loop-to-output rotation changes are small while translation shifts are centimetres. This is consistent with limited yaw correction.
interpretation.hypothesis_not_proven: The explicit 1/10 loop-yaw scale and local sequential-edge dominance are the strongest code/data-supported explanation; current artifacts do not establish that this is the sole or primary causal limiter.
interpretation.alternatives: PnP relative-yaw error, the five-iteration solver cap, Huber downweighting on loop-factor residual norms, and the 4DoF gravity-preserving design may also affect results. Per-factor effective robust weights and convergence traces were not recorded.

minimal_validation_proposal_for_next_goa.scope: Offline deterministic replay using captured 074-02 VIO keyframe poses, four verified loop constraints and the existing truth/return samples; no new simulation or control.
minimal_validation_proposal_for_next_goa.baseline_gate: Recreate the existing four-edge 4DoF solution with the current 0.1 loop-yaw residual scale, Huber(0.1), neighbor factors and five iterations; require it to reproduce the saved optimized keyframe poses and final corrected return-window result within predeclared numeric tolerances.
minimal_validation_proposal_for_next_goa.single_intervention: Change only the loop-factor yaw residual scale from 0.1 to 1.0; retain the same loop translations, neighbor factors, Huber loss, initialization, iteration limit and source data.
minimal_validation_proposal_for_next_goa.decision: If the replay baseline matches and the intervention lowers final loop-edge yaw residuals and seventh-return yaw RMSE without a meaningful position-RMSE regression, the weighting hypothesis gains support. If not, reject it as a sufficient explanation and investigate PnP yaw quality or optimizer convergence.

limitations: Read-only audit; no factor ablation or causal intervention was run.
The last graph snapshot contains final keyframe states; per-factor Huber weights and Ceres convergence summaries are not recorded.
This observer output is isolated from navigation and PX4; results are not flight qualification.
